Money grab. This app promises simple Bible verses on your lockscreen but delivers a frustrating experience wrapped in aggressive upselling and emotional manipulation. It feels exploitative, especially toward people genuinely exploring Christianity or looking for daily inspiration.
The core feature (lockscreen verses) requires a paid subscription, and the whole thing comes across as more focused on retention and revenue than helpful ministry. There are far better free alternatives like YouVersion’s Verse of the Day widgets or other reputable Bible apps that don’t pressure you or pry into your personal life.
If you’re new to faith or just want simple scripture reminders, steer clear. This preys on vulnerability rather than pointing people to the Bible itself. Uninstalling immediately

reviews.text: Hope and Restoration. When I tell you that the season that I have been enduring has kept me feeling lost, broken, sad, that would be an understatement. In the midst of the uncertainty that I am wrestling with daily, I’m clinging to God for the promise of his mercy, strength, love and guidance. He will never leave us nor forsake us, I have found countless refuge in those words in the midst of all that is weighing heavily on me. I pray for God to either block it or bless it & that goes for every relationship in my life. This app has been a huge blessing to me. I look forward to reading it daily. It feeds you the word of God, every single day. Do I still have struggles? Absolutely. But I rest in the assurance that when I’m praying for things to be better and then something happens, I have to realize that heaviness the devil feels and he tries to shake the ground I’m standing on because he hates that my eyes are to the Lord. Remember this, Nobody breaks into a house the kill steal and destroy that has no VALUE. Keep going. Seek him. And allow him to show you the restoration that can be built but the comfort of knowing that he is the ONE person that will never leave.
